notes.text: The minor is open to students not majoring in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Data Science, or minoring in Information Systems. To declare, complete CSE 114 (or CSE 160) and either CSE 214 (or CSE 260) or CSE 113 (or CSE 150), each with a grade of B- or higher. Priority is given to students with a GPA of 3.20 or higher in these CSE courses and a cumulative GPA of 3.00 or higher. For students with more than two CSE courses applicable to minor entry, the CSE GPA uses the highest grades earned in two of CSE 113, CSE 114, and CSE 214. At most one entry course may be repeated. Only courses transferred before matriculation can be used for entry. Admission is competitive and contingent upon program capacity.
CSE 150 may substitute for CSE 113 for minor entry. CSE 113 does not appear in the minor's course requirements.
Students who have declared the minor should see a Computer Science Undergraduate Advisor to discuss a suitable selection of Computer Science electives.
